note: Issue #610: how a race gate looks. Read by src/systems/racing/race_course.gd. A gate is two relay antennas (RelayAntenna, the droid relays' array) with a knee-high glowing strip between them. At rest the start/finish is `start` and a checkpoint `checkpoint`. A racer going through flashes it `pass` (anyone) or `you` (the player) at full `flash_energy`, then `mid` after mid_s, then back to rest at flash_s. One shared material per colour and step for every gate in the world (docs/RENDER_RULES.md: no per-gate materials, no real lights). strip_height, strip_glow and strip_pieces: the strip's height (m), how much brighter than the lamps it glows (a solid glow: see-through vanished into the red sand at dusk; it has no collider, you drive through it), how many points between the masts it checks the sand at (strip_samples), and how far over the sand it floats (strip_lift, m). It is one straight beam from one mast's foot to the other's, tilted with the slope; where a dune rises between them the whole beam lifts just clear of it. `emitter`: the beam comes out of a steel housing at each end, clamped to the mast by a bracket, with a lens that lights up with the beam: reach (m from the mast to the lens), radius and length of the housing.
